name: Indicative reference figures, 2021-2023
note: NOT OFFICIAL DATA. Approximate nominal GDP and mid-year population for 2021-2023 for thirty economies, plus oil and non-oil value added for the six GCC states, entered by hand so the insights pages have something to show and so a new compilation can be sanity-checked for order of magnitude. They are close to the published series but are not the published series, and no figure here should be quoted, cited or used in an analysis that leaves this application. Replace them with the official file before relying on any comparison: scripts/load-benchmarks.mjs pulls the World Bank indicators NY.GDP.MKTP.CD and SP.POP.TOTL and flips verified to true. It does NOT carry the oil split, which has no single international series and must come from each national statistical office. See DECISIONS.md D51.
